svg.title: Fictional handoff schedule
svg.desc: Read-only schedule snapshot. Every source task is retained. Exact dates, ownership and sources are in the companion HTML and JSON.

g.text: T-01, M-02 and R-03; external EXT-9 is outside snapshot
Calendar: Monday-Friday; 2028-02-29 holiday · [start, finish); finish is excluded
Gray: Supplied comparison; approval unknown · Blue: forecast · Green: actual · Diamond: event, not acceptance
No dated intervals — no date axis inferred
Fictional data. No acceptance evidence or percent-progress evidence supplied.
As-of date and all written dates retained without repair. Comparison approval is unknown.
Mapping assumption: the stated actual start belongs to T-01, the work item; no actual finish was supplied.
Display assumption: [start, finish) follows this renderer contract; source did not specify endpoint inclusion. Dates are unchanged.
Working days and holiday are supplied by the requester; owners and relationship lag calendars beyond this snapshot are unknown.
